# VB-CABLE Pack45 — original vendor package

Build-time source: https://download.vb-audio.com/Download_CABLE/VBCABLE_Driver_Pack45.zip

Size: 1,318,877 bytes. SHA256:
`b950e39f01af1d04ea623c8f6d8eb9b6ea5c477c637295fabf20631c85116bfb`

The complete, unmodified archive is embedded in the final EXE. Source checkouts
run `python scripts/fetch_vbcable.py` to obtain and verify it before building.
End users do not need a download connection to install the bundled driver.

VB-CABLE is by VB-Audio / Vincent Burel and is donationware. End users must be
able to identify its origin and support the author: https://vb-audio.com/Cable/ .
The current distribution policy permits bundling under those conditions:
https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm . It was checked on 2026-10-17.
The original archive's readme and license are preserved, and the application's
setup status and help visibly credit VB-Audio and its donationware model.

Only the standard VB-CABLE package is included, not the A+B or C+D products.
CloudMic's MIT license does not apply to this driver. Professional/organization
licensing has additional terms; consult the author's policy directly.
